label: Moving without one's own form's power is a per se link
paraphrase: A mover that moves something not by the power of its own form moves it only insofar as it is moved: it is a per se link of the mover series. Analyst formulation, open; motivated by ST I q.18 a.3 co. (the instrument acts not by the power of its own form but by that of the principal agent).
